adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Later, for collective team events, it does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which becomes a no-op when `destinationCalendar` is `null`. Since `teamDestinationCalendars` is populated from other hosts’ `user.destinationCalendar`, those calendars are silently not added in this case, matching the finding.
